description: This file defines a React component named 'Customer' that displays and manages customer orders within an e-commerce application. It connects to Redux for state management, handles order search and pagination, and renders various subcomponents for UI elements.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: A React component for displaying and managing customer orders, including search and pagination functionalities.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component's state with a search string.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches initial orders when the component mounts.

methods.name: handleOrderSearch
methods.description: Handles search input; triggers search if input length >= 2, otherwise clears search.

methods.name: handleOnPagination
methods.description: Handles pagination events to fetch orders for the selected page.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including search, order list, pagination, and loading states.
